title: Choose Alice's visual world
question: Keep the laundry-day direction, choose an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Laundry day for worktrees
options.lineage: wash-day sorting, folded linen, and hand-labelled laundry tags
options.thesis: Alice turns chaotic agent leftovers into a calm sorting ritual: inspect, fold, reclaim.
options.viewport: A familiar desktop worktree table dominates, with repository navigation left and evidence right; selected merged rows fold into one reclaimable batch.
options.risk: The domestic metaphor becomes cute if it interferes with the evidence table.

raised.raise: Flat colour owns the whole selected state rather than decorating its border.
Evidence opens beside the selected worktree while unrelated rows recede.
Every status uses one consistent plain-language sign and colour.
Worktree states read as a lifecycle: merged, active, protected, and needs review.

options.label: Alice's housekeeping ledger
options.lineage: a meticulous maid's household accounts and chore book
options.thesis: Every worktree is an entry Alice can account for before anything leaves the house.
options.viewport: A dense but readable audit table leads, with evidence aligned like accounts and a hand-drawn Alice checking the reclaimable total.
options.risk: This is the most familiar direction and could settle into generic editorial warmth.

options.label: Worktree departures board
options.thesis: Merged worktrees depart; active and delayed work stays on the board with unmistakable status.
options.case: Excellent row and state clarity, but the railway world identifies less strongly with Alice's personal housekeeping role.
options.viewport: A standard repository shell surrounds a precise status table; changed classifications ripple once into their new state.
options.risk: Dark transit styling can overpower the personal hand-drawn character.

options.label: Cleanup claim checks
options.lineage: jet-age ticket wallets and baggage claim stubs
options.thesis: Each cleanup candidate carries a claim check with its branch, destination, and evidence attached.
options.case: The coupon states make confirmed cleanup exceptionally clear; the travel ritual is less personal than laundry day.
options.viewport: Familiar filters and a worktree list lead; confirmation stamps selected rows as reclaimed without hiding their evidence.
options.risk: Stamps and coupons become novelty decoration if overused.

options.label: Typographic cleanup tiles
options.lineage: flat metro tiles and giant lowercase type
options.case: Bold identity, but tile navigation is less clear than a dense evidence table for this task.
options.kept: Flat colour owns the whole selected state.
options.viewport: Colour and type lead above a standard worktree list.
options.risk: The visual system competes with the task.

options.label: Agent session catalog
options.case: Game-adjacent browsing is familiar, but poster rows hide too much Git evidence.
options.kept: Selection brings evidence forward while unrelated rows recede.
options.viewport: Worktrees are browsed in focused groups with details on selection.
options.risk: Optimised for browsing rather than safe comparison.

options.label: Cleanup wayfinding
options.case: Excellent signs and states, but it does not strengthen Alice's identity or the hand-drawn brief.
options.kept: Every status has one consistent plain-language sign and colour.
options.viewport: Standard worktree navigation uses decisive status bands and clear next actions.

options.label: Branch lifecycle folio
options.lineage: botanical plates following a plant through its seasons
options.case: The branch lifecycle is apt, but the folio treatment is less immediate for repeated cleanup work.
options.kept: Worktree states read as a coherent lifecycle.
options.viewport: Worktree evidence is compared through consistent lifecycle states in a standard list.
options.risk: The metaphor encourages illustration where the user needs density.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished native Git maintenance app with a conventional sidebar, table, and inspector.
canonCard.viewport: Repositories left, sortable worktrees centre, evidence and cleanup action right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other developer utilities by design.
